## Rules

- Freeze exactly the descriptor/profile/invoker/idempotency/cursor/auth/error/
snapshot contracts documented in §1–§9; no release. Ratchet forbids second mutable API authority,
direct handler calls from HTTP/exposed-tool adapters, tenant fields in code-profile hash and any GraphQL
path/dependency/capability/snapshot. P14 consumer compile fixture may consume only frozen public surface.
Only root changelog; external sources go to `docs/reference.md` with date/purpose.

## Guidance

Root tests inspect actual bindings/routes/snapshots and execute one query, command,
async command and exposed tool. Reuse P3 tokenizer scanner for authority/GraphQL/direct-call checks.
Receipt is result evidence, not expected-output prose; planted failures run in `try/finally`.
